body:
After giving up taking Mushies, because of a bad trip brought on by extreme negativity of an assosiate who was present.
I along with some other guys started smoking the dried mushrooms as we had run out of weed, we were all heavy Cannabis users and our experiences ranged from nothing to a complete stupor. My personal result was exactly the same as had I smoked weed, just the usual euphoric (stoned) sensation, which passed after a simaler duration. This could easily be explained by my mindset at the time.
I have not done this again since as I had no idea what it was doing to me healthwise, and it tasted completly horrible, so I cant relate an experience free from the interference of Cannabis.
Phil,
